name: constraints_intentionally_empty
note_zh: 本图层刻意保持为空。文物保护范围与建设控制地带、控规控制线、道路红线、蓝线和市政管线均属锁定图层，目前没有可引用的官方几何来源；在缺少来源的情况下绘制控制线会构成伪精确控制结论，因此本方案将其列为缺资料事项而不是生成图形。
note_en: Deliberately empty. Heritage protection zones, regulatory control lines, road redlines, blue lines and municipal corridors are locked layers with no citable official geometry available; drawing them without a source would fabricate precise statutory control, so they are recorded as a data gap instead.
